The '''siege of Niele''' was a conflict that was caused by the [[Biskaran Pirates]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Niele system/Legends|Niele system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] broke the siege, although in the process Screed lost an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to a Biskaran [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] armed with a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siege of Niele was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
